parsed.name: 数字示波器
parsed.description: 数字示波器是一种用于采集、显示和分析电信号随时间变化波形的台式测量仪器，常见于电子电路调试、脉冲与时序信号观察、故障诊断以及教学实验中。该设备通常支持多通道输入，并可导出波形数据用于进一步分析。
parsed.description_en: A digital oscilloscope is a bench-top instrument used to acquire, display, and analyze electrical waveforms as they vary over time. It is commonly used for electronics debugging, pulse and timing analysis, fault diagnosis, and laboratory teaching. Such instruments typically support multiple input channels and can export waveform data for further analysis.
